independence: All baseline development scores were observed before this revision. The changed system-log inference had started; its complete result was not used to formulate this revision. Holdout-2 remains unopened; this is development tuning, not independent evaluation.
floorCandidates: Midpoints between consecutive distinct raw scores across complete development candidate scores. Evaluate each ordering after filtering, then take its first five distinct sources. No labels or query strings change.
ordering: Highest minimum positive Hit@5 across the four development fixtures
Lowest maximum no-answer false-positive rate across the four fixtures
Widest eligible critical-score interval (use its midpoint, not an observed score boundary)
Highest mean MRR across the four fixtures
Highest floor as deterministic final tie-break
onNoEligibleFloor: Do not enable the filter as an accepted candidate or evaluate holdout-2. Preserve failures and improve the development pipeline.
acceptance: A selected floor is a development candidate only. Freeze it and the complete runtime configuration before holdout-2 and actual answer/citation evaluation. No threshold change or label replacement after opening that set.
reason: The complete pre-alias calibration produced zero eligible combinations. The system-log retrieval alias changes one development question input; all other inputs were verified unchanged. Keep every numerical eligibility threshold and qrel unchanged.
runtime: Same pinned model/revision/score configuration; CPU threads 8 on BLRO for new inference. Reused scores are explicitly linked to identical model inputs from prior CPU threads 4 calibration; product-path and holdout evaluation must execute the final configuration.
